state.description: the state the feature was closed from

deleted.description: each shadow-repo ref deleted, with the SHA it pointed at; empty under --plan

gate_pr.description: the gate's draft PR that was closed (by this close, or by GitHub when its branch was deleted); null when none was open

needs_console.description: whether closing this feature takes a person at a console: false only for a published, merged and unmoved feature, or a merged one whose branch is gone and whose gate (if any) is for what was published (gate branch gone or at its candidate); always true for a record this binary can't read (corrupt or newer); set under --plan too

approval.description: how the close was approved; null under --plan, and when no console was needed

reparented.description: children moved onto main in the same atomic push that closed this feature
